viewer.title: Mostly a viewer
viewer.body: I am here to watch, comment and follow creators.

creator.title: Mostly a creator
creator.body: I want to publish videos and shorts and build a channel.

advertiser.title: An advertiser
advertiser.body: I represent a brand and want to reach 3Speak viewers.

shortsCamera.title: Shorts are a tab, not a different app
shortsCamera.body: Open Shorts from the top bar to watch, or use Share to post one. Vertical clips from your phone work as they are.

searchSlash.title: Press / to search
searchSlash.body: From anywhere on the site, the slash key jumps into the search box. It looks through videos, creators and communities.

communities.title: Communities gather people around one subject
communities.body: Join a few and their videos start showing up in your feeds. You can post into a community too, so the right people see it.

followFeed.title: Your follows have their own feed
followFeed.body: Once you follow a few creators, the follow feed is only their videos. It is the fastest way to stop scrolling past things you do not care about.

interests.title: Tell us what you are into
interests.body: Pick a few topics in Settings and the home feeds reweight towards them straight away. It works better than any amount of scrolling.

hideWatched.title: Watched videos can disappear from feeds
hideWatched.body: Settings has a "hide watched" switch, on by default, so the same video stops following you around after you have seen it.

timestamps.title: Comment on an exact moment
timestamps.body: While a video is playing, a comment can carry the timestamp you were at. Readers get a link straight to that second.

badges.title: Badges are given, not claimed
badges.body: People on Hive are awarded badges for events and milestones. Open one to see everyone who holds it and what they publish.

audio.title: 3Speak carries audio too
audio.body: Podcasts and music live under Audio in the top bar, with their own player. You can publish audio the same way you publish video.

backlog.title: Nothing you post now is wasted
backlog.body: Everything you publish during your warm-up can be republished to Hive under your own name once your account arrives, and you choose what comes with you.

trackChooser.saveFailed: That did not save. Please try again.

trackQuestion.title: What brings you to 3Speak?
trackQuestion.intro: Your path to a Hive account depends on it: viewers watch and join in, creators publish, and advertisers set up their brand.
trackQuestion.introNoAdvertisers: Your path to a Hive account depends on it: viewers watch and join in, and creators publish.

video.hint: Share something about you and what your channel will be about.
video.why: This is the first thing the team looks at when they review you, and the first thing a visitor sees when they open your channel.

counts.0: Any video you publish from the upload studio.
counts.1: It stays yours. When you are upgraded you pick which of these posts get published to Hive under your own name.

short.hint: Participate in 3Speak Shorts and upload some moments of your daily life or some stories you want to share.
short.why: Shorts are the fastest way to be found. They play in a feed of creators people do not follow yet, so a short reaches past your own channel.

counts.0: Vertical videos posted from the shorts uploader.

follow.hint: Build up a network of likeminded people, or creators you find exciting.
follow.why: Your following list is what turns the home feed into your feed. It travels with you to Hive when you are upgraded.

counts.1: Unfollowing someone lowers the count again, so this tracks who you actually follow rather than how many buttons you pressed.

comment.why: Comments are how people find you before you have an audience. One real reply under somebody else’s video will do more for you than an upload nobody has seen yet.
comment.hint_one: Comments count once they are at least {{count}} character. A real thought, not just “nice”.
comment.hint_other: Comments count once they are at least {{count}} characters. A real thought, not just “nice”.

counts.minChars_one: At least {{count}} character of your own words.
counts.minChars_other: At least {{count}} characters of your own words.
counts.realThought: A real thought rather than a single word.
counts.othersPost: On somebody else’s post. Replies under your own videos, or to your own comments, are a conversation with yourself and do not count.

watch.hint: Any videos. Counted while you are really watching.
watch.why: Watching says you are here to take part and not only to post. It is the goal most people finish without trying.

counts.1: Once per video. Rewatching one raises its best time, it never adds to it, and no single video can supply all of it on its own.

time.hint: This one finishes on its own. Nothing to do.
time.why: An account that appeared an hour ago and one that has been here a few days look the same on paper. The days are what tell them apart, so everyone waits the same short while.

counts.fullDays_one: A full day from the day you signed up.
counts.fullDays_other: {{count}} full days from the day you signed up.
counts.forYouWhen: For you that is {{when}}. The other goals can all be finished before then.
counts.otherGoals: The other goals can all be finished before then.
counts.keepsCounting: It keeps counting whether you are here or not, so there is nothing to keep up.

subscription.hint: Find communities about the things you like to watch or make.
subscription.why: Communities gather the videos on one subject and the people who care about it. Joining one fills your feed with more of what you like, and for creators it is where a new channel finds its first viewers.

counts.0: Communities you are a member of right now.
counts.1: Leaving one lowers the count again.

profile.hint: Your brand name, what you do and your logo.
profile.why: Viewers, and the team reviewing you, see who is behind an ad before anything else. A complete profile is what makes a brand recognisable and trustworthy.

contact.hint: An email, plus your address or a website.
contact.why: Before an ad runs, the team needs a real way to reach the business behind it. Your email and address are private: they are never stored on the blockchain or shown anywhere.

counts.2: You need your address OR a website in your brand profile above, at least one of the two.

progress.title: Your path to a Hive account
progress.needsTrack: Your list of things to do depends on what brings you to 3Speak.
progress.reviewDone: All done. The team will review your channel and upgrade you. Nothing more for you to do.
progress.reviewPending: Once you have completed all of these, the team will review your channel and upgrade you.

navProgress.titleComplete_other: All {{count}} goals done (100%). The team will review your channel.

what.title: Welcome to 3Speak
what.p1: 3Speak is a video platform built on Hive, a public blockchain. Videos here are not owned by us: they belong to the people who post them, and they can earn real rewards from the people who watch them.

warmup.title: You are in your warm-up
warmup.p1: A Hive account is real and permanent, and someone has to pay for it. So instead of asking you for anything up front, we gave you a name and a place to publish straight away.
warmup.p2: Everything you make during the warm-up lives on 3Speak. When you are ready, the team reviews your channel and gives you a Hive account of your own, free. Your videos, shorts and follows then go to the blockchain under your own name, and you choose what comes with you.

do.title: What you can do right now
do.upload: Upload videos, exactly as anyone else here does.
do.shorts: Post shorts from your phone or your desktop.
do.comment: Comment on anything, including videos by people already on Hive.
do.watch: Watch. Your history and your feed are yours from day one.
do.aside: A few things wait for your account: earning rewards and tipping. Those move real money, so they need an account that really is yours.

path.p1: Your profile shows a short list of things to do, and it depends on what you are here for: viewers watch and join in, creators publish, and advertisers set up their brand.
path.p1NoAdvertisers: Your profile shows a short list of things to do, and it depends on what you are here for: viewers watch and join in, and creators publish.
path.p2: It is not a test. It is simply how we can tell a real account from an empty or malicious one. Once the list is done the team reviews you and upgrades you as soon as possible.

earn.title: Your posts start earning.
earn.body: Videos on Hive can be rewarded in HIVE and HBD by anyone who watches them, and they can carry ads you take a share of.

publish.title: Publish everything you made here.
publish.body: The videos, shorts and follows on this page can be posted to the chain under your own name, and you choose which.

buttons.title: Vote, tip, follow and build playlists.
buttons.body: All the buttons that are greyed out for you today.

keys.title: Keys only you hold.
keys.body: Nobody can lock you out, and the same login works across every Hive app, not just 3Speak.

ecosystem.title: Be part of the global Hive ecosystem.
ecosystem.body: 3Speak is one app on a whole network of them: blogs, communities, games, marketplaces and more, all sharing the one account and the same following list.

book.title: Book ads across 3Speak.
book.body: Video spots, shorts spots, player banners, tickers and pre-upload spots, from one day to three months.

pay.title: Pay from your own wallet.
pay.body: In HBD or HIVE, straight from your account. No card and no middleman.

results.title: See what your ads delivered.
results.body: Plays and clicks for every booking, and credit back on your next one if a booking falls short.

customers.title: Talk to your customers, if you want to.
customers.body: Post videos, answer comments and follow people under your brand’s name.

keys.title: Keys only you hold.
keys.body: Nobody can lock you out, and the same login works across every Hive app, not just 3Speak.

note.graduated: Now on Hive as <userLink>@{{user}}</userLink>. Anything below was made before that.
note.advertiser: This is your brand page on 3Speak. Finish the steps below and the team reviews your brand. Once approved you get a Hive account: that is your advertiser account, the one you book ads with and pay from.
note.own: This is how others see you. Your posts live on 3Speak and are not on the Hive blockchain yet, so they do not earn rewards. That changes when you get your account after completing all the tasks below.
note.ownCreator: Your posts are kept in a warm-up space, but they are visible and highlighted on the main platform. While they are in the warm-up space, they do not earn rewards yet. That changes when you get your account, after you have completed all the tasks below and moved your videos over in a few simple steps.
note.ownViewer: You are in the warm-up. Your comments and follows are kept in a warm-up space for now and do not earn rewards yet. Once you have completed all the tasks below, you get your Hive account, and from then on everything goes straight to the main platform.
note.visitor: New here, not on Hive yet. These posts live on 3Speak, so they earn no rewards for now. Follow and comment anyway: early encouragement is what carries someone through their first weeks. When they get their Hive account we will tell you, so you can follow them there too.

market.audience: The audience waiting for your ad
market.format: Pick the format that fits your message

empty.advertiser: Videos here are for talking to customers, if you want to. Ads are booked separately on the Advertise page and do not need any.
empty.own: Nothing yet. Your first upload ticks off the list beside this.

profile.unlocksTitleAdvertiser: What your advertiser account gets you
profile.unlocksTitle: What a Hive account gets you
profile.fineprint: Saved to your 3Speak profile. It goes to Hive with everything else when you get your account.

empty.following: They are not following anyone yet.

bell.empty: Nothing yet. When someone replies to your videos or likes them, it shows up here.

rail.title: Just getting started
rail.body: New here, not on Hive yet. These posts live on 3Speak. Give them a warm welcome before they join Hive.

sessionSync.caughtUp: Your Hive account is ready, so this device has caught up with it.
sessionSync.title: Reconnect your session
sessionSync.lede: This device lost its connection to your account, so 3Speak cannot load your posts, progress or notifications until it is back.
sessionSync.text: Nothing has been lost. Everything you have made lives on your account, not in this browser. Reconnecting usually takes a second and no typing.

contact.savedComplete: Saved. Only the 3Speak team can see it.
contact.savedIncomplete: Saved. Add your address, or a website on your profile, to finish this step.
contact.privateNote: Private. Your email and address are never stored on the blockchain and never shown on your profile or anywhere else. Only the 3Speak team sees them, to reach you about your ads.
contact.addressOptional: optional, unless your profile has no website
contact.addressHint: An address counts once street, city and country are filled in. No address? Add a website to your brand profile instead.

brand.name: Brand name
brand.aboutPlaceholder: One or two sentences viewers will understand.
brand.logoHint: Shown as a circle next to your ads, so a square image works best.
brand.websiteOptional: optional if you give us your address
brand.websiteInvalid: Use a full address starting with https://

createAccount.started: Let’s set up your Hive account
createAccount.openFailed: Could not open account setup. Please try again.
createAccount.approvedAdvertiser: The team has approved your brand. Create your Hive account, for free, to book and pay for ads.
createAccount.approved: The team has approved you. Create your Hive account, for free: it is yours alone.

graduatedFollows.message: @{{handle}} now has a Hive account as @{{hiveUsername}}.
graduatedFollows.title: Someone you follow got upgraded

backlog.title: Your earlier posts are still here
backlog.lede_one: You made {{count}} thing before you had a Hive account. They live on 3Speak only. You can put them on Hive as @{{user}} whenever you like.
backlog.lede_other: You made {{count}} things before you had a Hive account. They live on 3Speak only. You can put them on Hive as @{{user}} whenever you like.
backlog.text: You pick what goes across, one by one. Anything you leave stays on 3Speak exactly as it is, and you can come back to the rest any time.

advertiser.lede: The team has reviewed {{name}}. Create your Hive account, for free: it becomes your advertiser account.
advertiser.text: With it you book ads across 3Speak, from video spots and banners to tickers, and pay for them straight from its wallet, in HBD or HIVE. The key is yours alone, so nobody can lock you out.
advertiser.note: Your brand profile comes across with you. Your business email and address stay private with 3Speak and never go on the blockchain.
advertiser.noteMoving: Your {{moving}} come across too, published gradually over a few days.

viewer.title: Your own account is ready
viewer.ledeDone: As @{{handle}} you have {{done}}. Turn that into a Hive account that belongs to you, for free.
viewer.lede: Turn @{{handle}} into a Hive account that belongs to you, for free.
viewer.text: With it you can vote on and tip the videos you like, earn from your comments, opt in to viewer rewards for what you watch, and build playlists. The same login and the same follows work across every Hive app, and the key is yours alone.

creator.title: You can create your own account now
creator.lede: You have been posting as @{{handle}}. Turn that into a real Hive account that belongs to you, for free.
creator.text: A Hive account is a key only you hold. Nobody can lock you out of it, your posts start earning, and the same login works across every Hive app, not just 3Speak.

note.everything: Everything you have made here comes across with you.
note.gradual: Publishing happens gradually over a few days, because a brand new account starts with a small posting allowance.
note.waiting_one: One of them waits for the post it answers to be published first.
note.waiting_other: {{count}} of them wait for the posts they answer to be published first.

handleTaken.openFailed: Could not open the name picker
handleTaken.title: The name @{{handle}} has been taken
handleTaken.lede: Somebody registered it on Hive, so it cannot become your account when you are ready. Picking a new one now takes a moment.
handleTaken.text: Choosing a name here never reserved it. Hive has no way to hold a name short of creating the account, and that is the step you have not paid for yet, which is the whole point of starting without one.
handleTaken.note: Nothing you have made is lost. Your videos, shorts, comments and follows stay with you and come across under whichever name you choose.

backfill.rcError: Not enough resource credits yet. They refill on their own; try again shortly.

groups.videoNote: One every 5 minutes — this is the slow part.

backfill.waitToast: Hive allows one post every 5 minutes. Next one in {{wait}}.
backfill.emptyText: Everything you made before you had a Hive account has either been published or was not something that can be republished.
backfill.title: Publish what you made earlier
backfill.intro: You made these on 3Speak before you had a Hive account, so they only exist here. Pick what you want on your public record as @{{user}} and publish it. Anything you leave stays on 3Speak exactly as it is.
backfill.note: Publishing takes a while, and that is normal. Hive allows one post every 5 minutes per account, and a brand new account has a small posting allowance that refills over a few days. Follows, likes and your profile are cheap and go through quickly. Publish a few at a time and come back.
backfill.rcBlockedIn: Your account is out of resource credits for the moment. Hive gives every account a small allowance for posting, and it refills on its own. Nothing is lost: come back in about {{wait}} and carry on where you left off.
backfill.rcBlockedLater: Your account is out of resource credits for the moment. Hive gives every account a small allowance for posting, and it refills on its own. Nothing is lost: come back a little later and carry on where you left off.
backfill.rootPostsTime_one: {{count}} video, so this needs about {{minutes}} minutes
backfill.rootPostsTime_other: {{count}} videos, so this needs about {{minutes}} minutes
backfill.nextVideo: Next video can go out in {{wait}}. Follows, likes and profile are not affected.
backfill.waitingText: These publish by themselves once the post they point at goes up on Hive. Nothing is lost in the meantime.
